subject: Publisher account & offer readiness — legal terms, availability and portal provisioning
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Azure Marketplace Portal <mpn-support@microsoft.com>, Contoso Marketplace PDM <marketplace@contoso.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@contoso.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T09:12:00Z
Subject: Publisher account & offer readiness — legal terms, availability and portal provisioning

Team / Azure ops / Contoso PDM,

Quick summary: Contoso is ready to publish their SaaS offer (Contoso AI Studio) but the marketplace portal validation is failing on a few spots and we need to confirm legal/availability clauses before we request validation re-run. Action items below.

High-level asks:
- Confirm publisher tenant provisioning (we currently do not see Contoso tenant linked to the publisher ID).
- Confirm whether the offer needs a separate IP indemnity clause for EU availability (Contoso asked about multi-region pricing).
- Guidance on manifest errors (attached manifest + screenshot of portal validation).
- DocuSign link for co-sell agreement (Procurement) so Contoso can sign.

Attachments: contoso-offer-manifest.json, contoso-offer-summary.pdf, screenshot-validation-error.png

Notes from tech review (raised by our onboarding):
- Fulfillment type: SaaS (SaaS Fulfillment 2.0) — ARM template referenced in manifest points to a VM image SKU instead of SaaS plan id.
- OAuth redirect/client IDs: missing entry in offer registration (expected in the manifest under properties.identity).
- SKU plan metadata: friendly display name is longer than allowed 60 chars (portal truncation causes failure).

Proposed next steps:
1) Azure: confirm what exact manifest fields are blocking acceptance (if you can re-run the validator and paste the error codes that would help).
2) Contoso: can procurement sign the co-sell terms by EOD Tue (we will attach DocuSign link)?
3) Redwood: we will prepare a corrected manifest and minimal ARM/test package by tomorrow noon PT.

I'm available for a 30-min validation call this afternoon between 2–4pm PT if anyone from Azure ops wants to join (I'll keep it focused: manifest + tenant linkage + co-sell flow).

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Azure Marketplace Portal <mpn-support@microsoft.com>, Contoso Marketplace PDM <marketplace@contoso.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Publisher account & offer readiness — legal terms, availability and portal provisioning

Rishi / team —

Thanks for the concise breakdown. Quick replies:
- I can take the manifest clean-up (will remove the VM SKU reference and replace with the SaaS plan id). I already trimmed the plan display name to 56 chars and fixed the identity block.
- Camila, can you confirm Contoso has assigned the publisher tenant admin role to marketplace@contoso.com (we saw the "tenant not linked" error in the portal screenshots).
- Markus, please prepare a minimal test package (sample OAuth config + manifest) and upload to the shared Drive link so Azure can re-run validations.

Proposed call: 2027-04-22 14:30 PT / 17:30 ET — short 25 min slot. If Azure Ops confirms availability, I will send calendar invite.

Laura
Sr. Manager, Partner Onboarding
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Azure Marketplace Portal <mpn-support@microsoft.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Contoso Marketplace PDM <marketplace@contoso.com>
Date: 2027-04-23T13:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Publisher account & offer readiness — legal terms, availability and portal provisioning

Hello Redwood / Contoso team,

Thanks for the submission. We re-ran the automated validator against Offer ID contoso-offer-az-9876 and here are the consolidated findings (priority order):

1) properties.pricingDisplayName exceeds 60 characters — please shorten (Error: AZ-MP-1021).
2) properties.fulfillment.type mismatch: manifest declares "SaaS" but referenced template contains a VM image resource (Error: AZ-MP-2007). Replace template or update fulfillment to SaaS-FULFILLMENT and provide sample callback URL for telemetry.
3) properties.identity.clientId not present — OAuth flows require a registered client id for SaaS offers (Error: AZ-MP-3010).
4) Publisher tenant not authorized to the offer (publisherId mismatch) — share publisher-admin role to marketplace@contoso.com or provide the publisher tenant GUID.

What we need from Contoso / Redwood to unblock:
- Updated manifest (see attached manifest schema example: https://learn.microsoft.com/marketplace/offer-manifest-schema).
- A test SaaS fulfillment endpoint or mock URL that returns 200/OK for validation run.
- Confirmation that Contoso procurement signed co-sell terms; send DocuSign signed copy or token so we can mark co-sell eligibility.

DocuSign: We can accept the powerform link you provided; note the co-sell agreement window remains open for 10 business days after issuance.

I can be available for the proposed 2027-04-22 14:30 PT slot only if you can shift to 15:00 PT — otherwise we can do 2027-04-23 08:00 PT. Confirm preferred slot and we'll send an invite.

Regards,
Azure Marketplace Onboarding (MPN Support)
mpn-support@microsoft.com
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Azure Marketplace Portal <mpn-support@microsoft.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Contoso Marketplace PDM <marketplace@contoso.com>
Date: 2027-04-23T15:48:00Z
Subject: Re: Publisher account & offer readiness — legal terms, availability and portal provisioning

Thanks, Azure team.

Update from Contoso side: procurement has signed the co-sell via DocuSign (I uploaded the signed powerform receipt to the Drive link). Publisher admin role was assigned to marketplace@contoso.com earlier this morning; Markus also pushed an updated manifest to the shared Drive (link below) with the following changes:
- pricingDisplayName shortened to 54 chars
- replaced VM image with SaaS fulfillment stub and added a mock callback endpoint https://contoso-fulfillment-test.contoso.com/health
- identity.clientId field populated with a test client id (temp-client-id-12345)

Link to updated package: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-offer-assets

Could Azure re-run validation and confirm which remaining errors (if any) persist so we can sign off and request publish? Also requesting the 15:00 PT slot today if that's still possible.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Partner Onboarding, Redwood Inference
camil a_reyes@redwood.com
